name: DepTableExt Main
brief: Main test app: invokes a procedure on a tableextension defined in a DEPENDENCY app.
description: Proves that runner-compiled tableextension code in a dependency app is correctly registered on records (via RegisterParsedTableExtensions / _extensionIdsByBaseTable) and that the AL InvokeAsync path reaches it — the cross-bundle analogue of the RS CU74486 posting path where a precompiled BaseApp tableextension was not found.
